fb_text:
Back in March, one of my techs mentioned a gate latch was loose at a property. Nobody wrote it down. By June, the client was calling about the busted latch — and asking what else we'd missed.

That's how clients leave. Not over the big stuff. Over the little thing you meant to go back to.

FieldNotes catches it. Your crew voice-notes between stops, same as they always talk. Anything they flag — a loose latch, a supply to bring back, a follow-up to handle — lands in one queue. It stays in your daily summary until it's done.

Nothing lives and dies in a text thread anymore.

I built it for my own business — a commercial plant service running 50+ corporate and commercial properties in the Metro Atlanta area. The follow-ups are exactly why it exists.

See it work in the 60-second demo:
fieldnotesapp.io/app/try.html
